notes: Derived edit (likely); replaces the round-2 Blender/copyleft edit, whose second world (the GPL becoming permissive) was dropped by the verifier: the GPL's copyleft is entailed by its own terms and by firm facts outside the chain (GPL enforcement against other companies, the LGPL being a weaker copyleft), so that premise cannot give way. Here both premises are contingent relations between individuals. "Rocky Linux is a rebuild of RHEL" and "RHEL is derived from Fedora" are stated, but Rocky Linux is never called Fedora-derived (0 exact hits). Rocky Linux (2021) is used rather than CentOS, whose early releases (forked from RHEL 2.1, before Fedora existed) would make the original date-dependent. The new value Knoppix (2000) predates RHEL (2002), so w2 (RHEL derived from Knoppix) breaks no dates. The transitivity query crosses from the Red Hat family to the Debian family through the bridge Knoppix -> Debian, so it discriminates. Premise-route query goes through "the distribution Rocky Linux is built on" (RHEL in w2). Near: Rocky Linux's founder, untouched by its lineage.
